notes: Grown on a placed farm tile; a tile without a farm object is rejected (src/journey.js gardenAction).
A single tend shortens growth by five minutes, capped by the growth still ahead of the crop.
Seeds themselves are free and unlimited; the twenty-crop cap is the only garden constraint.
